description:
UI Front End Web Apps Developer 
 

 On behalf of our client, Procom Services is searching for a UI Front End Web Apps Developer for a contract opportunity in Hillsboro, OR.
 

 UI Front End Web Apps Developer Job Details 
 

 The person hired will be responsible for building a user facing portal for managing the Pre-Production samples. The portal needs to interact with a system for managing the devices using Service-now(http://wiki.service-now.com) 
 

 UI Front End Web Apps Developer Mandatory Skills 
 

 - Overall five years of experience build web applications. 
 - 3 years of experience building UI front end for Web applications. At least one year of which is using HTML, Bootstrap, CSS, Frameworks/Libraries like AngularJS, Ruby on Rails, DoJO, JQuery 
 - One year of experience preferred in building portals using CMS. The Content Management System (CMS) is a ServiceNow application that primarily enables users to create a custom interface for the ServiceNow platform and ServiceNow applications. The CMS application is powerful and flexible, so customers have used it for a wide variety of projects from creating entire websites to integrating with other products. The Content Management application is active by default. 
 - One year of experience preferred in building Inventory management systems for Validation labs. 
 - Demonstrable work experience with SOAP and REST API. 
 - ServiceNow is a desired skill but not a hardstop if the candidate has everything else.
 

 UI Front End Web Apps Developer Start Date 
 

 ASAP
 
 
 UI Front End Web Apps Developer Assignment Length 
 

 12 months


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Please send your resume in Word format only.
